title: Morning Session - 2025 Meeting
description: In the morning session , Warren Buffett, and Berkshire Vice Chairmen Greg Abel and Ajit Jain discuss tariffs and trade, the company's long-term plans for its Japanese stock holdings, and why investors need to stay calm amid stock market swings that Buffett calls minor when compared much bigger moves over the decades.
